newsitem.title: USA: Sports Authority sees Q2 below analyst views.
newsitem.headline: Sports Authority sees Q2 below analyst views.

text.p: Sports Authority Inc said Monday it expects second quarter earnings per share to be about $0.30, below analysts' consensus estimates of $0.34 a share.
The company earned $0.29 per share in the same period of the prior year.

The company said sales are expected to be about $382 million in the second quarter, with comparable store sales down an estimated 1.5 percent from the prior year, and comparable store sales adjusted for stores cannibalized by new store openings up by about 0.3 percent.

Chairman & Chief Executive Jack Smith said in a statement "While we are pleased with the positive trends we are experiencing in athletic footwear, team sports, and golf, they have not compensated for some of the negative trends in the in-line skates, fitness, and outdoor categories."
"We continue to see declines in the in-line skate business, and the positive impact of abdominal exercisers we experienced in the prior year has not been replaced in the fitness category."
Additionally, he said, the prior year quarter was helped by increased sales and heightened marketing of sporting goods during the Olympics.
Smith said that the company was on schedule to open its first distribution center this year and will launch its new advertising campaign shortly.
